PRIOR FINDINGS: both v1 blockers RESOLVED and re-verified against source, not only against the new prose - B1 because magit-status-mode-map binds j to magit-status-jump (magit-status.el:391) so R4's live-binding check genuinely passes for j, and magit-status-jump has no o suffix at this revision (keys z t n i u s / fu fp pu pp a w / j), confirming v2's claim that o is free; B2 because D1 now states the per-group asymmetry and R2 makes untracked->show the required increment, with HIDE=t re-confirmed at magit-status.el:797 (D1 cites :793, the enclosing defun). SIX DIMENSIONS re-triaged: only architecture/design warrants discussion; the other five skip with recorded reasons (v2 added the failure contract, honest reversibility, and distinguishing tests). NEW FINDINGS: D1 should-fix - cross-buffer visibility restore is not self-installing. magit-restore-section-visibility-cache runs unconditionally at magit-mode.el:917, but the preserve half is added to kill-buffer-hook in exactly one place, magit-refs.el:328, inside magit-refs-refresh-buffer and with no LOCAL arg. That explains the coordinator's default-value probe and the earlier baseline false negative, but it also means the hook only exists after a refs buffer has been refreshed once; in a status-only session, kill/recreate preserves nothing, making R6 rows 5 and 10 nondeterministic. Suggested fix is to pin the precondition in the row. D2 nit - D4 recommends M-x magit-zap-caches, which drops the repository's whole magit-repository-local-cache entry and the blob cache, broader than the visibility cache D4 discusses. Also confirmed git update-index --refresh is in the status refresh path (magit-status.el:467), so R6 row 12's stat-metadata allowance is well founded. ALL EVIDENCE SOURCE-DERIVED OR DOCUMENT-DERIVED: no Emacs started, no Elisp evaluated, no emacsclient, no fixture, no timing, no screen capture.
